name: TextEditor
description: Native text composition remains intact for IMEs; newline inserts a line, Escape cancels.
signature: ({ value, style, onPreview, onCommit, onCancel }: TextEditorProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Cancels on Escape or the cancel button.

props.name: onCommit
props.description: Commits on blur, Ctrl/Command+Enter, or the finish button.

props.name: onPreview
props.description: Reports draft input; the session wrapper uses this only for transient previews.

props.name: style
props.description: CSS placement in the containing stage. Image coordinates do not mirror.

props.name: value
props.description: Text spec at the beginning of this edit. Remount with a new key to edit a different layer.
